text:
### Instruction:
Respond to a customer asking about a late order

### Context:
Order #4521 shipped 5 days ago and has not arrived

### Response:
We apologize for the delay on order #4521. We have escalated this with our carrier and expect delivery within 2 business days.

### Instruction:
Respond to a customer requesting a refund

### Context:
Customer bought a defective headset last week

### Response:
We are sorry to hear about the defective headset. A full refund has been processed and will reflect in 3-5 business days.

### Instruction:
Respond to a customer asking about return policy

### Context:
Customer wants to return an unopened item

### Response:
You can return any unopened item within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Just include your order number with the return.

### Instruction:
Respond to a customer asking to change shipping address

### Context:
Order has not shipped yet

### Response:
We have updated the shipping address on your order. It has not shipped yet so the new address will be used.

### Instruction:
Respond to a customer asking about a discount code

### Context:
Code expired yesterday

### Response:
We understand the code expired recently. As a one time courtesy we have applied a 10 percent discount to your account.

### Instruction:
Respond to a customer asking about subscription cancellation

### Context:
Customer wants to cancel monthly plan

### Response:
Your subscription has been cancelled and you will not be billed again. You can continue using the service until the end of this billing cycle.

### Instruction:
Respond to a customer asking why their account was locked

### Context:
Multiple failed login attempts detected

### Response:
Your account was temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. We have sent a password reset link to your email.

### Instruction:
Respond to a customer asking about warranty coverage

### Context:
Product is 6 months old and stopped working

### Response:
Your product is still under our 12 month warranty. We will send a replacement unit at no cost to you.
